capabilities: Insert dialogue, monologue, narration, direction, and cast-change blocks via shortcuts or right-click menu
Pick the speaking character with a fuzzy search picker
Color-code dialogue and monologue blocks per character and show avatar portraits in reading view
Discover characters automatically from vault notes carrying a configurable character tag
Edit or delete blocks through hover actions or by editing the underlying callout Markdown
extras: Author states it is a WIP that may change or break, development will tilt toward their personal needs rather than generic use, and continuous support is not guaranteed. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it from a personal need to organize dialogues without inserting special characters or complicated combinations, for story writing in a game they are working on.
problem: Obsidian has no structured way to write game dialogue and narration; authors must insert special characters and manual formatting to keep speakers and scenes visually distinct.
summary: Storytelling toolkit that inserts structured, visually distinct dialogue, monologue, narration, direction, and cast-change blocks styled like visual novels.
